data.narrative:
SkySafe, a Series B defense and security company founded by Grant Jordan, is assessed against a comparable universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and stage. Key comparables include Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), alongside public benchmarks DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Two triangulation methods are applied. Stage-progression analysis uses SkySafe's $50M+ total capital raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $95M. Peer-median analysis across the 7 same-stage, same-sector private comparables establishes a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B, reflecting material dispersion in the cohort.

The combined analysis supports a valuation range of $81M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $548M. Stage-progression and peer-median methods diverge significantly, with the latter anchored to higher-valued comparables that may or may not reflect SkySafe's relative market position, execution maturity, or customer base depth. Key uncertainties center on revenue traction, defensibility of the technology stack relative to named peers, and whether SkySafe's operational metrics align with the upper or lower quartile of the peer set.
